parameters.query:
SELECT e.id, e.account, e.contact, e.campaign, e.occurred_at,
       coalesce(nullif((SELECT c.rep_email FROM clients c WHERE c.id = e.client_id), ''), (SELECT value FROM app_config WHERE key='rep_notification_email')) AS rep_email,
       (SELECT p.raw_payload FROM pipeline_runs p WHERE p.company = e.account ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS raw_payload,
       (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('type', a.action_type, 'status', a.status, 'executed_at', a.executed_at) ORDER BY a.id) FROM actions a WHERE a.account = e.account) AS touches,
       (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('event', ev.event_type, 'at', ev.occurred_at) ORDER BY ev.id DESC) FROM (SELECT * FROM engagement_events x WHERE x.account = e.account AND x.id <> e.id ORDER BY x.id DESC LIMIT 6) ev) AS recent_engagement,
       (SELECT o.objective_label FROM campaign_objectives o JOIN campaigns cam ON cam.id = o.campaign_id WHERE cam.account = e.account ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS objective
FROM engagement_events e
WHERE e.event_type = 'meeting_booked'
  AND e.occurred_at BETWEEN now() - interval '10 minutes' AND now() + interval '45 minutes'
  AND coalesce(e.metadata->>'prepped', '') = '';

UPDATE engagement_events SET metadata = coalesce(metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('prepped', true, 'prepped_at', now()::text) WHERE id = {{ $('Build Prep Sheet').item.json.event_id }} RETURNING id;
